Atlanta Halloween Bar Crawls 2026: BeltLine Nights, Midtown Energy

VIEW BELTLINE EVENT DETAILS & TICKETS

Saturday, October 31 | 6 PM–midnight | Atlanta BeltLine Eastside Trail

Bar Crawl USA brings Boos & Booze back to Atlanta with neighborhood-specific Halloween bar crawl editions. The confirmed BeltLine crawl takes over the Eastside Trail on October 31; this page keeps the BeltLine and Midtown choices easy to compare without mixing details between them.

BeltLine check-in begins at BrewDog Krog District before the route moves through 6+ haunted hotspots. The official listing includes two complimentary shots, discounted drinks, a professional photographer, a $100 costume contest at BrewDog, a crawl map and lanyard, and no cover at participating BeltLine bars.

Midtown event facts will only be added from an official 2026 Halloween listing. Until that source is confirmed, use the BeltLine event page below for current schedules, route updates, and tickets.

BrewDog to the Eastside Trail: Atlanta’s Halloween Route, Built for One Big Night

WHAT YOUR BELTLINE TICKET UNLOCKS

Two complimentary shots, published drink specials, a professional event photographer, a $100 costume contest at BrewDog Krog District, a crawl map and lanyard, and no cover at participating BeltLine bars. Every inclusion comes from the official event listing.

ROUTE SNAPSHOT

Start at BrewDog Krog District, then follow the published route through Ranger Station, Eclipse di Luna, Guac y Margs, Chiringa, One Flew South, McCray’s Tavern, Duke’s Hideaway, Northern China Eatery, and THChill Lounge. Venue order and timing can change, so check the official event page before heading out.

PLAN YOUR NIGHT

Arrive early enough to complete registration before the route fills in. Use rideshare or confirm parking independently, keep your official crawl map handy, and treat the event listing as the live source for last-minute bar and schedule updates.

ATLANTA BELTLINE • OCTOBER 31 • VIEW EVENT DETAILS

Costumes, Crews, and the $100 BeltLine Showdown

Atlanta costumes do not need a theme committee. They need commitment. The official BeltLine listing includes a $100 costume contest at BrewDog Krog District, so arrive ready for photos and keep your entry wearable enough to move comfortably between bars.

COMING WITH A CREW?

Use the official event listing for any current group offer rather than carrying a discount from another market. Coordinate check-in before the group disperses, choose a rideshare meeting point, and save the BeltLine route on every phone. The best group costume is the one that still works at the last stop.

Saturday, October 31 from 6 PM to midnight along the Atlanta BeltLine Eastside Trail. Registration begins at BrewDog Krog District.

The published route includes BrewDog Krog District, Ranger Station, Eclipse di Luna, Guac y Margs, Chiringa, One Flew South, McCray’s Tavern, Duke’s Hideaway, Northern China Eatery, and THChill Lounge.

Saturday, October 24 and Saturday, October 31 | 4 PM–10 PM | Cleveland area

Cleveland-area crawlers have two distinct Boos & Booze options in 2026. West Park runs Saturday, October 24 from 4 PM to 10 PM, while Lakewood runs Saturday, October 31 from 4 PM to 10 PM. Compare the two editions below before choosing the official event page.

West Park registration runs from 4 PM to 7 PM at West Park Station, with five published bars, two complimentary shots, drink specials, a map and lanyard, a $100 costume contest, and an official after-party. Lakewood’s current event headline confirms October 31 from 4 PM to 10 PM; we have corrected the outdated date that still appears in its body copy.

Two Cleveland-Area Crawls, Two Neighborhood Routes

WEST PARK • OCTOBER 24

Register at West Park Station, then crawl PJ McIntyre’s, Smedley’s, Throwbacks, and Backstage Bar before returning to West Park Station for the official after-party. The official listing includes two complimentary shots, published drink specials, a map and lanyard, and a $100 costume contest.

LAKEWOOD • OCTOBER 31

The published Lakewood lineup includes Around the Corner, Halloween Corner Bar, Harry Buffalo, West End Tavern, Riverwood Café, Mercury Lounge, Lakewood Truck Park, and Wine Dive. Its official listing includes two complimentary shots, drink specials, a photographer, costume contest, map and lanyard. Check each event page before arrival for live timing and route updates.

Pick Your Neighborhood, Then Commit to the Costume

What is included with a Cleveland Halloween crawl ticket?

Each official listing includes two complimentary shots, published drink specials, a map and lanyard, and a costume contest. West Park adds a $100 contest and official after-party; Lakewood also lists a photographer.

October 24 or October 31, 2026 in West Park and Lakewood.

West Park begins at West Park Station. Lakewood uses its published neighborhood lineup beginning with Around the Corner. Use the matching official event page for current route order.

Lakewood’s current event headline confirms October 31 from 4 PM to 10 PM; we have corrected the outdated date that still appears in its body copy.

Two Cleveland-Area Crawls, Two Neighborhood Routes

WEST PARK • OCTOBER 24

Register at West Park Station, then crawl PJ McIntyre’s, Smedley’s, Throwbacks, and Backstage Bar before returning to West Park Station for the official after-party. The official listing includes two complimentary shots, published drink specials, a map and lanyard, and a $100 costume contest.

LAKEWOOD • OCTOBER 31

The published Lakewood lineup includes Around the Corner, Halloween Corner Bar, Harry Buffalo, West End Tavern, Riverwood Café, Mercury Lounge, Lakewood Truck Park, and Wine Dive. Its official listing includes two complimentary shots, drink specials, a photographer, costume contest, map and lanyard. Check each event page before arrival for live timing and route updates.

Pick Your Neighborhood, Then Commit to the Costume

West Park and Lakewood each publish costume-contest plans, but their routes and dates are distinct. Choose the edition that fits your weekend, coordinate registration with your crew, and use the matching official event listing for any last-minute policy, venue, or ticket update.

What is included with a Cleveland Halloween crawl ticket?

Each official listing includes two complimentary shots, published drink specials, a map and lanyard, and a costume contest. West Park adds a $100 contest and official after-party; Lakewood also lists a photographer.

When do the West Park and Lakewood crawls run?

October 24 or October 31, 2026 in West Park and Lakewood.

What are the published Cleveland-area routes?

West Park begins at West Park Station. Lakewood uses its published neighborhood lineup beginning with Around the Corner. Use the matching official event page for current route order.

Where do I find official updates and tickets?

Use the West Park or Lakewood official event page for tickets and live event updates.

Columbia SC Halloween Bar Crawl 2026: The Vista After Dark

VIEW COLUMBIA DETAILS & TICKETS

Saturday, October 24 | 5 PM–11 PM | The Vista

Columbia’s Boos & Booze Halloween Bar Crawl takes over The Vista with 6+ published stops, two complimentary shots, drink specials, a costume contest, crawl map and lanyard, and an official after-party.

Use the official event listing for current registration instructions, bar timing, and tickets. The route below is the published crawl lineup, not a generic city guide.

A Halloween Route Through the Heart of The Vista

WHAT YOUR TICKET UNLOCKS

Two complimentary shots, published drink specials, an official after-party, map and lanyard, access to 6+ listed bars, and the event’s costume contest.

PUBLISHED ROUTE

VIEW GREENVILLE DETAILS & TICKETS

Saturday, October 24 | 5 PM–11 PM | Downtown Greenville

Greenville’s Boos & Booze Halloween Bar Crawl connects the city’s published downtown stops with two complimentary shots, drink specials, a costume contest, official after-party, and a crawl map with lanyard.

The official event page remains the source for registration, ticket availability, and live route changes. Use the route below to plan rideshare, parking, and a crew meetup before the night starts.

A Downtown Greenville Route with Eight Published Stops

WHAT YOUR TICKET UNLOCKS

Two complimentary shots, published drink specials, the official after-party, map and lanyard, and the costume contest listed for the event.

PUBLISHED ROUTE

Carolina Ale House, TakoSushi, Jack n’ Diane’s Dueling Pianos, DT’s Tavern, Lost & Found, Sharkey’s, Reys, and Abanico. Arrive early, confirm parking independently, and check the official event page for current venue timing.

Downtown Greenville, Fully in Costume

Portland ME Halloween Bar Crawl 2026: Old Port Boos & Booze

VIEW PORTLAND DETAILS & TICKETS

Saturday, October 24 | Crawl 4 PM–10 PM | Old Port

Portland’s Boos & Booze Halloween Bar Crawl runs through the Old Port with two complimentary shots, published drink specials, a photographer, $100 costume contest, map and lanyard, and an official after-party. The headline’s crawl window is 4 PM to 10 PM; the published route continues to the Porthole after-party at 11 PM.

Use the official event page for registration timing, ticket availability, and any final route changes.

From Fore Play Registration to an 11 PM Porthole After-Party

WHAT YOUR TICKET UNLOCKS

St. Pete Halloween Bar Crawl 2026: Downtown Boos & Booze

VIEW ST. PETE DETAILS & TICKETS

Saturday, October 24 | 4 PM–10 PM | Downtown St. Petersburg

St. Pete’s Boos & Booze Halloween Bar Crawl connects 7+ downtown bars with two complimentary shots, published drink specials, a photographer, costume contest, crawl map and lanyard, registration, and an official after-party.

Use the official event page for current check-in details, ticket availability, and any bar or schedule updates before arrival.

A Downtown St. Pete Route from Dublin Drop to Thirsty First

WHAT YOUR TICKET UNLOCKS

Two complimentary shots, published drink specials, a professional photographer, costume contest, registration and official after-party, map and lanyard, and access to 7+ published bars.

PUBLISHED ROUTE

Dublin Drop registration, Who’s on First, Dublin, One Night Stand, Tequila Daisy, Pelican Pub, The Landing, Five Bucks Drinkery, Pour Judgement, Crafty Squirrel, Henley, Where’s Jubes, and the Thirsty First after-party. Verify live timing on the official page before heading downtown.

ST. PETE • OCTOBER 24 • EVENT DETAILS

St. Pete Costumes Made for the Camera

A photographer and costume contest are part of the official listing, so bring a look that can survive a full downtown route. Coordinate registration and a final meetup with your crew, then rely on the event page for last-minute updates.

GET ST. PETE EVENT DETAILS & TICKETS

Frequently Asked Questions

Costumes, Crews, and the $100 BeltLine Showdown

What is included with the St. Pete Halloween crawl ticket?

Two complimentary shots, drink specials, photographer, costume contest, registration, after-party, map and lanyard, and 7+ bars.

When and where does the St. Pete crawl run?

Saturday, October 24, 4 PM to 10 PM in Downtown St. Petersburg, Florida.

What is the published St. Pete route?

Dublin Drop registration through the published downtown lineup to the Thirsty First after-party.

Where do I find official updates and tickets?

Use the official St. Pete event page for tickets and live route updates.

Macon GA Halloween Bar Crawl 2026: Downtown After Dark

VIEW MACON DETAILS & TICKETS

Saturday, October 31 | 6 PM–midnight | Downtown Macon

Macon’s Boos & Booze Halloween Bar Crawl covers 10+ downtown bars with four complimentary shots or cocktails, published food and drink specials, a photographer, costume contest, registration, after-party, and crawl map with lanyard.

Use the official event listing for current registration instructions, ticket availability, and final route timing.

A 10+ Bar Downtown Macon Halloween Route

WHAT YOUR TICKET UNLOCKS

Roswell GA Halloween Bar Crawl 2026: Canton Street After Dark

VIEW ROSWELL DETAILS & TICKETS

Saturday, October 31 | 3 PM–10 PM | Downtown Roswell

Roswell’s Boos & Booze Halloween Bar Crawl moves through 6+ downtown bars with two complimentary shots, published drink specials, a photographer, $100 costume contest, crawl map and lanyard, and an official after-party.

Registration begins at North End Kitchen. Use the official listing for current ticket availability, check-in instructions, and last-minute route changes.

North End Kitchen to the Rock N Taco After-Party

WHAT YOUR TICKET UNLOCKS

Two complimentary shots, professional photographer, $100 costume contest, published drink specials, map and lanyard, official after-party, and access to 6+ bars.

PUBLISHED ROUTE

North End Kitchen registration, The Vick, Stout Brothers, Madrid Tavern, Ipp’s Pastaria, Ceviche, Lola’s Tequila Bar, The Artillery Room, Gate City Brewing, and Rock N Taco after-party. Check the official event page before heading downtown.

ROSWELL • OCTOBER 31 • EVENT DETAILS

Canton Street Costumes Competing for $100

Roswell’s official listing includes a photographer and a $100 costume contest. Choose a look that stands out while staying comfortable across the downtown route, then coordinate registration and the Rock N Taco meetup with your crew.

GET ROSWELL EVENT DETAILS & TICKETS

Frequently Asked Questions

What is included with the Roswell GA Halloween crawl ticket?

Two complimentary shots, photographer, $100 costume contest, drink specials, map and lanyard, after-party, and 6+ bars.

When and where does the Roswell GA crawl run?

Saturday, October 31, 3 PM to 10 PM in Downtown Roswell, Georgia.

What is the published Roswell GA route?

North End Kitchen registration through the published Canton Street lineup to Rock N Taco after-party.

Where do I find official updates and tickets?

Use the official Roswell event page for tickets and live route updates.

Sarasota Halloween Bar Crawl 2026: Downtown Boos & Booze

VIEW SARASOTA DETAILS & TICKETS

Saturday, October 31 | Registration 3 PM–6 PM | Downtown Sarasota

Sarasota’s Boos & Booze Halloween Bar Crawl includes two complimentary shots, published drink specials, a photographer, $100 costume contest, crawl map and lanyard, and an official after-party across 6+ downtown bars.

The current event headline does not publish one complete operating window. Registration is confirmed at Raffurty’s from 3 PM to 6 PM, and the published route continues through the 10 PM after-party. Use those confirmed times rather than an invented start-to-finish range.

Raffurty’s Registration to the 10 PM After-Party

WHAT YOUR TICKET UNLOCKS
